Generated from fixture.c using Apple Clang's AArch64 Linux ELF backend:
  clang --target=aarch64-linux-gnu -O2 -fno-ident -c fixture.c -o fixture.o

The fake __this_module payload deliberately does not claim kernel ABI validity.
